_comment: AarogyaMP — Synthetic test personas (Reference §16). NEVER use real patient data. These are fabricated for development/testing only.

personas.label: LOW risk — minor cold/fatigue
personas.raw_text: I have a mild runny nose and feeling a bit tired since yesterday. No fever, no chest pain.

personas.label: MODERATE risk — fever + body pain 2 days
personas.raw_text: I have fever since two days, headache and body pain. Feeling weak.

personas.label: HIGH risk — chest tightness + breathlessness
personas.raw_text: I have chest tightness and feeling breathless when walking. Started 3 hours ago. I am also sweating a lot.

expected._note: Rule engine should NOT flag this as emergency (thresholds are clinical decisions). AI should return HIGH.

personas.label: EMERGENCY — vitals-triggered (SpO2 critical)
personas.raw_text: I am having difficulty breathing and feel very confused. I feel faint.

expected._note: SpO2 85 + BP 85/50 + HR 140 should trip EMG_VITALS_CRITICAL once clinician thresholds are set.

personas.label: EMERGENCY — keyword-triggered (severe chest pain)
personas.raw_text: I am having severe chest pain radiating to my left arm. I cannot breathe properly. This started 10 minutes ago.

expected._note: Severe chest pain + can't breathe should trip EMG_KEYWORD_MATCH once clinician keyword list is set.
Validator must catch these before they reach the rule engine or LLM.
